com.apple.trustd: Checks the certificates of secure connections, and whether a certificate has been revoked, for apps and macOS.
com.apple.nsurlsessiond: Downloads and uploads files in the background on behalf of apps and macOS, so transfers continue after an app quits.
com.apple.apsd: Keeps a connection to Apple's push notification service, which delivers notifications and wake-ups for apps.
com.apple.akd: Signs in to your Apple Account and keeps it authenticated for Apple services.
com.apple.cloudd: Syncs app data with iCloud through CloudKit.
com.apple.bird: Syncs iCloud Drive files and documents.
com.apple.cloudphotod: Syncs your photo library with iCloud Photos.
com.apple.mDNSResponder: Looks up names for the whole Mac (DNS) and finds devices on the local network (Bonjour).
com.apple.softwareupdated: Checks for and downloads macOS and security updates.
com.apple.mobileassetd: Downloads system assets macOS uses, such as fonts, dictionaries, voices and machine-learning models.
com.apple.timed: Sets the clock from network time servers.
com.apple.locationd: Provides Location Services; it can look up nearby Wi-Fi networks with Apple to find the Mac's position.
com.apple.geod: Downloads maps, places and location data for Maps and other apps.
com.apple.parsecd: Fetches suggestions for Spotlight, Safari and Look Up.
com.apple.identityservicesd: Registers your devices for Messages, FaceTime and other Apple services that use your phone number or email address.
com.apple.imagent: Sends and receives messages for the Messages app.
com.apple.rapportd: Talks to your other nearby Apple devices for Continuity features such as Handoff and Universal Clipboard.
com.apple.sharingd: Handles AirDrop, Handoff and other sharing between your devices.
com.apple.syspolicyd: Gatekeeper: checks apps when they open, including whether Apple has notarized them.
com.apple.storedownloadd: Downloads App Store purchases and app updates.
com.apple.WebKit.Networking: Loads web content for Safari and for apps that show web pages.
com.apple.CalendarAgent: Syncs your calendars with the accounts they belong to.
com.apple.accountsd: Manages the internet accounts set up on this Mac.
com.apple.icloud.searchpartyd: Find My: locates your devices and items.
com.apple.netbiosd: Looks up the names of Windows (SMB) computers on the local network.
com.apple.networkserviceproxy: Handles iCloud Private Relay and other network proxies macOS manages.
com.apple.configd: Sets up the Mac's network connections, including getting an address from the network (DHCP).
com.apple.itunescloudd: Syncs your Apple Music and iTunes library.
com.apple.ScreenTimeAgent: Syncs Screen Time settings and reports between your devices.
com.apple.tipsd: Downloads content for the Tips app.
com.apple.helpd: Downloads help pages for apps and macOS.
com.apple.analyticsd: Sends diagnostic and usage data to Apple, if you turned on sharing in Privacy & Security › Analytics & Improvements.
com.apple.SubmitDiagReports: Sends crash and diagnostic reports to Apple, if you turned on sharing in Privacy & Security › Analytics & Improvements.
